messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The reporting service has a deploy window on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-03-05 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-05]
- The product catalog has a deploy window on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC as of 2025-11-12. [constraint; valid 2025-11-12 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-12]
    earlier: The product catalog has a deploy window on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-05-02 to 2025-11-12; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-05-02-2]
- The webhooks service has a deploy window on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21]
- The job scheduler has a deploy window on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays. [constraint; valid 2025-08-08 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-08-08]
    earlier: The job scheduler can be released on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC; any other release time requires an exception. [constraint; valid 2025-03-21 to 2025-08-08; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-21]
- The authentication gateway has a deploy window on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-04-14]
- The reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy, as noticed by Cinder on 2025-08-20. [valid 2025-08-20 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-20]
- Billing-api has a deploy freeze from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 during the peak season. [constraint; valid 2025-11-11 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-11-11]
- The reporting service still relies on the event bus as of 2025-11-13. [valid 2025-11-13 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-13]
- The event bus deploys only on weekdays after 15:00 UTC per the change policy. [constraint; valid 2026-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-17-2]
    earlier: The event bus deploys on weekdays after 15:00 UTC per the change policy. [constraint; valid 2025-04-22 to 2026-03-17; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-04-22]
- Team Dune noticed on 2025-09-18 that the flags service's p99 latency doubled following Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-09-18 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-18]
- The reports pipeline is not a Boreal service. [valid 2025-06-06 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-06-06]
- Boreal announced at standup on 2026-03-13 a deploy freeze for Ledger from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 for the fiscal year close. [constraint; valid 2026-03-13 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-13]
- The reporting service was moved off direct Ledger queries because nightly Ledger scans were blocking billing runs. [valid 2025-09-19 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-19]
- The reporting service must stay on Python 3.11 until the pandas 3 upgrade lands. [constraint; valid 2025-05-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-05-15]
- As of 2026-05-01, Ledger deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC instead of on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC. [decision; valid 2026-05-01 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-05-01]
- Team Atlas adopted a no-deploy Friday as of 2025-01-31. [constraint; valid 2025-01-31 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-31]
- Boreal reported at standup on 2026-02-04 that the scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump. [valid 2026-02-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-02-04]
- Team Atlas observed on 2025-11-11 that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-11-11 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-11-11]
- The webhooks service's request volume halved following the client rollout. [valid 2025-04-22 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-04-22-2]
- The reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change. [valid 2025-06-06 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-06-06]

Question: What is the deploy window of the service that reporting depends on?

The event bus deploy window: "The event bus deploys only on weekdays after 15:00 UTC per the change policy." [valid 2026-03-17 to now] — this is the current one. Earlier: "The event bus deploys on weekdays after 15:00 UTC per the change policy." [valid 2025-04-22 to 2026-03-17]
